answer_2.quote: We first use surface-level metrics for evaluating the LLM generated answers, which compare the similarity of the generated longform answer with the gold standard through textual overlaps. These include ROUGE... BLEURT-20... BERTScore...

answer_3.quote: In addition to traditional surface-level metrics, we also use LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate the quality of the generated text... we employ Llama 3.1 70B, GPT-4o, and GPT-4o-mini to evaluate LLM-generated answers on four aspects, namely relevance, accuracy, completeness, and conciseness.
methods: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using prompts to score aspects

answer_4.quote: To assess human proficiency, the authors compared human-written responses from 28 annotated QA pairs against those generated by GPT-4... each instance included a question, a ground truth answer, an author-written answer after reading the paper, and a GPT-4 generated answer; with evaluations focusing on comprehensiveness, factuality, and clarity.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators compared human-written and GPT-4 generated answers, rating them on comprehensiveness, factuality, and clarity.
